entities.summary: Haj Qorban Soleimani was an Iranian celebrated dotar player and vocalist. Dotar or Dutar is a form of Central Asian lute. Haj Qorban Soleimani was a composers & musicians from Quchan (1920, Quchan–2008-01-20). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
